inputs.text: [excited] He was 2 meters long — as long as a motorcycle! [amazed] Standing up, it would come up to your waist! And he weighed 150 kilos — [serious] as heavy as a donkey!
[playful] As heavy as a donkey, but with flippers?
[chuckles] With flippers, yes — [confident] made of fingers, like one big flat hand.
